next_question: Can session_invalidation behavioral variance be designed to preserve TP >= 0.85 (all session_invalidation samples correctly detected as drift) while achieving within-condition std > 0, breaking the TP/variance trade-off identified in this experiment?
why_next: The experiment resolved the parent's MEASUREMENT_INVALID (now 8/8 conditions have variance, n=240) and produced a valid confirmatory orthogonality test (|r|=0.1387, p=0.031), but the frozen decision_rule FAILs because C1_drift_tp cannot be satisfied. The 50/50 session validity randomization that creates behavioral variance also creates false negatives (valid sessions produce behavioral=0, counted as drift miss), yielding mean_tp=0.729 < 0.85. The audit identifies this as a fundamental design trade-off (V1_C1_FAIL_BY_DESIGN_ARTIFACT), not a measurement flaw. The next design must achieve variance without diluting TP — either by varying session_status_check intensity while keeping session_change=1 for all drift samples, or by restricting the confirmatory test to permission_boundary conditions only with wider stochastic variation.

established: Permission_boundary behavioral signals (token validation failure rate, session state change, auth boundary shift) measured from real HTTP on Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT HS2.14.0 localhost achieve TP=1.0 (Wilson lower 0.886) on all 4 PB co-occurring conditions and tolerate all 4 structural noise patterns with FP=0.0. Replicated identically across parent EXP-GRAPH-35166507358 and this experiment (audit V8 confirms no leakage, per-condition RNG isolation).

Unauthenticated /schema endpoint provides structural observability independent of auth state: 8/8 co-occurring conditions have both behavioral>0 AND structural>0, fixing parent zero-imputation confound where signing_key_rotation masked structural signal to 0.0.

Pooled Pearson r=0.1387 (|r|<0.3, permutation p=0.031) on 240 paired samples survives C3 in isolation. However, this is a heterogeneous pooled estimate: PB r=0.051 (n=120, p=0.577) and SI r=0.189 (n=120, p=0.038). Pooled significance is driven by SI subset, not uniform orthogonality.
Permission_boundary-only pooled r=0.051 (n=120, p=0.577) replicates parent EXP-GRAPH-35191029030 exactly, confirming PB behavioral-structural orthogonality is stable across experiments.
Null control FP=0.0 on 120 noise-only samples replicates across experiments. Behavioral signals do not false-positive on structural noise without drift.

Six structural/schema-based signal families remain falsified for C-FRESHNESS frozen gate in deterministic mock: Jaccard, TF-IDF, response-time KS, linear Fisher LDA ensemble, field-usage profiling, direct schema comparison.
rejected: Session validity randomization via 50/50 coin flip as a path to valid orthogonality test — achieves C2 variance (8/8 conditions std>0) but breaks C1 TP (mean 0.729 < 0.85) by creating false negatives when sessions are randomly valid (audit V1_C1_FAIL_BY_DESIGN_ARTIFACT)

recommended_action: Redesign session_invalidation behavioral variance mechanism to preserve TP >= 0.85 while achieving within-condition std > 0. The audit suggests three approaches: (a) vary session_status_check intensity while keeping session_change=1 for all drift samples (e.g., vary /session/status response latency, body field content, or graded TTL expiry window that still yields 401 but with variable session_status_check weight — this preserves detection because session_change=1 fires for all drift samples while session_status_check provides within-condition variance); (b) define TP threshold to include session_status_check contribution (redefine TP as behavioral_composite > 0 OR session_status_check > 0, so valid sessions with session_status_check=0 still count as detected when session_change=1); (c) preregister separate TP thresholds per drift pattern (PB threshold separate from SI threshold). If the TP/variance trade-off is irreconcilable for session_invalidation, restrict the confirmatory pooled test to permission_boundary conditions only (n=120, r=0.051, p=0.577) with wider stochastic variation (all 7 non-empty permission subsets, n>=60 per condition) and preregister per-drift stratification. Either path should also: correct noise-only sample size to 240 per spec, isolate structural signal for response_time_jitter conditions (fix baseline capture to avoid seed-drift artifact), and align prereg stochastic variation model with execution.
